ignoreRules.reason: Only the sidebar uses width/transition (collapse 256px<->64px on user click). It's a discrete user interaction, not a continuous animation, and switching to transform would break the push layout (main reflows to fill the space). DESIGN §layout: push sidebar requires animating the column width, not the layer transform.

ignoreValues.reason: Single-family rule per DESIGN.md §3 — ops console used 8h/day, density-first; distinctive display faces fight the brief
Focus ring radius (not a surface). DESIGN.md §5 token scale applies to surfaces; focus rings use a lighter radius to avoid competing with the outline.
Monospace accent for operational numeric data via .login-meta-mono with tabular-nums. Single-Family rule applies to reading text; operational numbers use monospace by convention.
